tana: Quick ops check for Wed microlab — main asks: public replay up for 72h, clip highlights to HS, and capture which CTA variant drove signups.
emily: I'm on reg page edits. We'll use two CTAs: Variant 1 = 'Watch Now' and Variant 2 = 'Get Replay'. Small copy change only.
josh: Zoom checklist done: cloud recording, enable SRT captions, alternative host assigned. I'll also disable participant video by default to reduce noise.
tana: Nice. Emily, can you drop a hidden field into the HubSpot form to record the cta param? Name it hs_cta_variant.
emily: Yep. Snippet I'll add to the page (will push after review):
```html
<script>
  (function(){
    const p = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const v = p.get('cta') || 'variant_control';
    const f = document.querySelector('input[name="hs_cta_variant"]');
    if(f) f.value = v;
  })();
</script>
```

marco: Who owns the clip extraction once the mp4 shows up in S3? We need 4x ~20s social clips + full replay. Suggested clip inpoints: 00:03:50, 00:15:30, 00:27:10, 00:44:05.
s3-bot: Recording received: s3://redwood-recordings/microlab/3742599999_session.mp4 clip task enqueued.
analytics-bot: Lead update: 198 registrants captured. HubSpot mapping queued: cta -> hs_cta_variant, referrer -> hs_referrer.
josh: Plan: S3 should have raw recording within 25m of end, automated clip jobs + SRT packaging done ~75-90m. We'll then run transcript->summary job for social copy.
tana: Email flow: immediate confirmation, 12h reminder for live registrants, and replay email after T+1h once clips ready. Draft line: "Couldn't make it? Watch the full session or jump to 4 highlights."
emily: Minor wording change: use 'Full Session' instead of 'full session' for subject case. Also add UTM params: utm_source=microlab_email, utm_campaign=microlab-mar, utm_content={cta}.
marco: For CTA analytics: HubSpot workflow should tag contacts with the variant. If variant=Get Replay -> add them to replay drip; else -> live reminder sequence. Can someone create the workflow?
analytics-bot: I can create the report. Need: CTR by cta_variant, replay watch rate (unique viewers / registrants), and MQL conversions from clip CTAs. Delivery: Thu morning.
josh: QA: schedule a 25m playback QA slot 90m after end to check caption sync and clip boundaries. I'll own it.
emily: Social assets: @marco please overlay brand pack and export 3:5 vertical clips for IG stories. Need by T+5h. Brand pack: https://assets.redwood.ai/brand/apr-kit.zip
tana: Good. Also, make sure replay links include file id and UTMs, e.g. https://replay.redwood.ai/v/3742599999?utm_source=microlab_email&utm_campaign=microlab-mar&utm_content=watchnow
marco: Quick note on metrics capture: include the cta_param as a hidden cookie too so if they convert later we have attribution.
emily: I'll add cookie write: document.cookie = `hs_cta_variant=${v}; path=/; max-age=${60*60*24*7}`
analytics-bot: Reminder: retention policy set to 90 days for recordings. Also logging an event when clip job finishes to populate HS replay_url.
s3-bot: Clips and SRT available: expected T+75m.
tana: Thanks team. Final checklist: reg page snippet pushed by 09:30 PDT, Zoom host briefing at 10:00 PDT, post-event QA slot booked T+90m, analytics report Thu AM. Ping if anything slips. :rocket:
